capabilities: Copy a text selection with note path, line numbers and heading path
Copy a folder as an ASCII tree
Output as Markdown, XML tags or plain text
Exclude folder patterns like node_modules from trees
extras: Handles multiple cursors and reading view by mapping selections back to the original Markdown blocks; output is for manual pasting, no direct AI integration.
problem: Copying text out of Obsidian loses where it came from, so pasted excerpts lack the note path, line numbers and heading context an AI agent needs to open the source file.
summary: Clipboard tool that copies selected text with note path, line numbers and heading path, or a folder as a tree, ready to paste into an AI chat or agent.
